article.title: MADRID SOLIDARITY
article.author: Housing Justice Commission
article.content: Madrid Tenants Union expresses solidarity with US tenants! Solidarity from the Madrid Tenants Union to tenants, tenant unions, and organizers in the US! The struggle against private property and capitalism is truly universal, and we in DSA can make a massive contribution by organizing our buildings, forming new tenant unions, and joining the ones that already exist in our areas.
